name: Fransaskois (Canada)
description: A square yellow field with a green Nordic-style cross set toward the hoist and a red fleur-de-lis in the lower fly.
history: The Fransaskois flag, representing the French-speaking community of Saskatchewan, was designed by André Girard and adopted in 1979. Yellow stands for the wheat fields, green for the boreal forest and the fleur-de-lis for the French heritage.
